mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the permission matrix fact allows Alloy to assign any Role->OperationKind combination as Allowed, immediately violating LeastPrivilege (e.g. HospitalAdministrator -> RecordLookup becomes permitted). The injection forces exactly the violating cell to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermMatrixViolation { HospitalAdministrator -> RecordLookup in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing care-team gating allows a Permitted RecordLookup operation to exist for a clinician with no active CareTeamMembership, violating the core ownership-based access invariant. The injection forces such an operation into the model.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamGatingViolation { some op: Operation | op.opKind = RecordLookup and op.opOutcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.ctmClinician = op.opCaller and m.ctmPatient = op.opPatient and m.ctmStatus = ActiveStatus) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the append-only note fact allows a ClinicalNote to exist that is not produced by any permitted AddNote operation, or allows two permitted AddNote operations to produce the same note object, violating the one-note-per-operation invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyNotesViolation { some n: ClinicalNote | no op: Operation | op.opKind = AddNote and op.opOutcome = Permitted and op.opNote = n }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the audit-immutability fact allows an AuditEntry to exist that is not owned by any Operation, representing a spurious or orphaned audit record, which violates the bijection between Operations and AuditEntries that the AuditCompleteness assertion checks.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyAuditViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | no op: Operation | op.opAudit = ae }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the audit-completeness fact allows two distinct Operations to share one AuditEntry, or an Operation to have no AuditEntry, directly contradicting the always-on one-to-one audit requirement from FR-012.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenesViolation { some disj op1, op2: Operation | op1.opAudit = op2.opAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the administrator-cannot-access-clinical-content fact allows a HospitalAdministrator to have a Permitted RecordLookup operation, meaning the administrator could observe clinical content, violating the content-blindness invariants.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminNotClinicalViolation { some op: Operation | op.opCaller.userRole = HospitalAdministrator and op.opKind = RecordLookup and op.opOutcome = Permitted }
